title.zh: CoinEx quits after 9 years as crypto trading activity concentrates at biggest exchanges
title.en: CoinEx quits after 9 years as crypto trading activity concentrates at biggest exchanges

current_state.zh: CoinEx is winding down after nine years, ending spot trading on Sept. 29 and withdrawals on Dec. 22 due to falling revenue and rising compliance costs, as roughly 88% of tracked trading volume remains concentrated at Binance, OKX, MEXC, Bybit, and Gate.
